title: Managed Database: contract activation
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database contract activation applies to database activate. The contract status is applied. The contract contract approval is approved. Activate an approved application after provisioning evidence confirms the configured resources; record activation time from the current handling clock. Refuse rejected or pending applications. Setup is invoiced under lifecycle and bank fees when setup fee is positive; a waived setup fee creates no charge. Repeating an activation of an already active contract is a read-only confirmation, not another activation.

## Evidence: contract state
The contract status is applied. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database contract reference, status. The correlated evidence must refer together to database contract reference. 

## Evidence: provisioning approval
The contract contract approval is approved. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database contract reference, contract approval. The correlated evidence must refer together to database contract reference.
